about: A self-hosted service that stores images and resizes or converts them on request.

prs.title: Transparent images turn into JPEGs with the right background
prs.broken: Converting a transparent image to JPEG gave it a black background, and asking for another background color changed nothing. Rounded corners came out black too.
prs.changed: Transparent areas are now filled with the chosen color, white by default, before saving as JPEG.
prs.matters: Logos and icons look right when served as JPEG.
